hardest_step: Use the positive mass in the flat conformal Dirac square, control its gradient cross term, and nest local energy estimates without charging M per derivative. Weaken the row separation explicitly; keep both commutators, physical endpoint factors and the actual middle inverse.
consequence: The complete fixed-seed middle trace through three covariant derivatives has normalized constant 1e22 instead of 1e26. The actual gluing part separately has explicit fixed-coordinate derivatives through nine. This is a quantitative source input, not the finite-metric source H6 bound or the cancellation certificate.

primary_sources.location: Section 15.2, Proposition 15.5 and its proof, printed page 79, PDF index 78; inspected 2026-10-21. Search snippet's section 14.2 is stale and is not the cited locator.
primary_sources.established_result: Conformal covariance of the geometric Dirac operator; the dimension-two formula identifies the local flat variable-mass equation after spinor rescaling.
primary_sources.does_not_supply: The quantitative coercive recurrence, seed chart bounds, actual cap-row separation, angular sum or charged-source estimate. These are derived in the ordinary note with the Euclidean skew-adjoint convention explicit.

source_screening: The inspected Kashkynbayev-Oralsyn Caccioppoli paper treats a different nonlinear Dirac-p-Laplacian problem and supplies none of the numerical constants here. No estimate is imported from it.
comparison: The earlier proven j<=3 row estimate costs j!(2000M)^j and yields complete middle K_m=1e26. Simply extending it to j=9 would be unproved. The new finite interior recurrence removes M from the derivative coefficients at the explicit cost of a weaker exponential exp(-M/176) per row. Monotonicity of the exact paired angular summand gives the full sum <=4C*88^2. The unchanged local UV/restoration bounds complete only the three-jet result. Earlier endpoint C5 and all physical gates remain unchanged.
verification_scope: Exact coefficient, separation, finite recurrence, endpoint, Fourier, angular and source budgets; independent variable-mass Dirac energy integrals at 60 and 90 digits with a cross-term omission control; guard-point angular sums with an explicit uncomputed tail. Fixtures do not evaluate the actual quantum kernel or benchmark C, and numerical quadrature is supplementary rather than an interval proof.
